description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the ParameterOptionVisitor class, verifying its handling of various search parameter options such as limit, sort, cursor, and size within a query-building context.

classes.name: ParameterOptionVisitorTest
classes.description: Unit tests for ParameterOptionVisitor, testing handling of limit, sort, cursor, and size options in search queries.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up mock objects and initializes ParameterOptionVisitor before each test.

methods.name: constructorWithNullExpressionFactory
methods.description: Ensures constructor throws NullPointerException if expression factory is null.

methods.name: constructorWithNullQueryBuilder
methods.description: Ensures constructor throws NullPointerException if query builder is null.

methods.name: visitLimitOption
methods.description: Verifies that a LimitOption correctly invokes skip and limit on the query builder.

methods.name: visitSortOptionWithSingleSortOption
methods.description: Tests that a single sort option results in the correct sort expression being applied.

methods.name: visitUnsupportedSortExpression
methods.description: Confirms that an unsupported sort expression causes an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: visitSortOptionMultiple
methods.description: Checks that multiple sort entries are processed correctly and result in multiple sort expressions.

methods.name: visitLimitOptionAndSortOption
methods.description: Validates handling of combined limit and sort options.

methods.name: visitCursorAndSizeOptions
methods.description: Ensures cursor and size options modify the query builder appropriately.
